ValidationRule.description: DEPRECATED - 243758 - No Open Opportunity when manually changing Account to "Available" Validation
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Prevent_Assign_To_Available_With_Open_Opportunities ) , ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) , ( Owner.LastName = 'Available' ) , ( Count_of_Pending_Oppty__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Open Opportunities Exist, please move any opportunities to Closed/Lost with the appropriate Close/Lost Reason.
